title: one piece movie RED
gut_reaction: One Piece Film: Red diverges from traditional shōnen formulas by staging an operatic musical tragedy through Uta's mesmerizing dreamscape.
full_review: One Piece Film: Red diverges from traditional shōnen formulas by staging an operatic musical tragedy through Uta's mesmerizing dreamscape. Ado's vocal power carries the emotional weight of the entire narrative, turning every concert performance into an explosive spectacle. Shanks and the Red Hair Pirates finally delivering on decades of built-up mythos makes the climax undeniably legendary.

title: Spirited Away
gut_reaction: Miyazaki’s magnum opus operates with dream logic so flawless that every spirit, radish monster, and soot sprite feels grounded in ancient truth.
full_review: Miyazaki’s magnum opus operates with dream logic so flawless that every spirit, radish monster, and soot sprite feels grounded in ancient truth. Joe Hisaishi’s "One Summer’s Day" melody unlocks immediate tears. A film that cleanses the spirit every time you watch it.

title: Spider-Man: Across the Spider-Verse
director: Joaquim Dos Santos, Kemp Powers, Justin K. Thompson
gut_reaction: The Gwen Stacy watercolor mood-shifting world in the opening 20 minutes alone is more artistically daring than the last decade of studio animation.
full_review: The Gwen Stacy watercolor mood-shifting world in the opening 20 minutes alone is more artistically daring than the last decade of studio animation. Daniel Kaluuya’s Hobie Brown (Spider-Punk) stealing every scene with torn-paper punk aesthetics is cinema at its most joyful.
